openHAB 5.3.0 M5 is an open-source system for home automation, designed to keep data local and run without cloud services.

It supports Windows, macOS, Linux and Raspberry Pi, and requires Java.

Devices and services are connected through add-ons called “bindings”; the system supports more than 300.

It also works with protocols including Zigbee, Z-Wave, MQTT, KNX and Bluetooth.
